title: From behind · the seawall
logline: Wood returns to the pages in June, as a back. The seawall. The crow. The bird isn't here yet.

panels.composition: The seawall at the foot of main street, July evening. WOOD from behind, sitting on the wall, the flannel, the stoop, BARNABY II beside him. A crow on the wall three feet away. The bay. The page has one figure and he is a shape.

image.prompt: a man seen only from behind sitting on a stone seawall at evening with a small three-legged dog beside him and a crow perched three feet away on the wall, the bay beyond, spare ink and soft slate-and-ochre watercolor, no panel borders, no words
image.notes: The From Behind sequence: Wood as a back, a shoulder, a reflection, for six months.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Wood returns as a back. The crow, not the bird.
